verdict.rationale: The evidence shows developer primitives for running agents: Runner.run/run_sync/run_streamed, pausing and resuming runs via RunState, and sandbox workspaces. None of it documents a product feature for setting up automations that run autonomously in the background, such as schedules, triggers or background jobs. The durable Temporal approach in the community post is an external tool, and async runs are building blocks a developer would use to construct the capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
